min_risk_score.description: Rows with a `risk_score` at or above this are kept (0–10).

url.description: The CSV's `https://` URL; null = alphaMountain's published list.

branch.description: The branch to follow; left out: the repository's default branch. Tags are never followed.

token.description: A read-only GitHub token, as `${secret:name}`; sent to GitHub only.

date_line_regex.description:
A regular expression for the list's date line; its first capture group (or the whole
match) is the time of the last change. Without it, a comment line such as
`! Last modified: …` or `# Updated : …` is used.

headers.description:
Extra request headers. Any header but `Accept`, `Accept-Language`, `Cache-Control`,
`Content-Type`, `Pragma` and `User-Agent` takes only `${secret:name}` references; headers
go to the URL's host only, never across a redirect.

url.description: The list's `https://` URL (a query is part of it; no user info or fragment).

/feed-presets.description: Two feeds of one GitHub provider: threat domains (malware, phishing, scam), and ads, tracking, telemetry, phishing and malware (adblock syntax).
/feed-presets.title: HaGeZi Threat Intelligence Feeds and Multi ULTIMATE

/feed-presets.title: AdGuard DNS filter

/feed-presets.description: Blocks public names that answer with private, loopback, link-local or CGNAT IPv4 addresses. Names in a profile's forward zones aren't filtered, so local names still resolve.
/feed-presets.title: Private IPv4 (DNS rebinding)

/feed-presets.description: Blocks public names that answer with loopback, unique-local or link-local IPv6 addresses. Names in a profile's forward zones aren't filtered, so local names still resolve.
/feed-presets.title: Private IPv6 (DNS rebinding)
